function mountScene3d(canvas, loadModule?): Promise<Scene3dHandle | null>

Defined in: core/utils/gpu/scene3d.ts:264

Mounts the scene3d engine on canvas: loads the artifact, runs the async mount (adapter + device + configure), wires a ResizeObserver feeding device-px resize, and returns the live handle. Resolves null on ANY capability/artifact/init failure — the caller keeps its existing renderer, so mounting can never regress the page.

Parameters

canvas

The scene's dedicated canvas element.
